Choosing the right English language test is one of the most important steps for international students planning to study in the UK. With more universities accepting online assessments, the Duolingo English Test (DET) has become a popular option among students who want a flexible alternative to traditional English exams.

Many Duolingo accepted universities in UK allow international applicants to submit DET scores as proof of English proficiency. However, acceptance depends on several factors, including the university, course type, study level and admission requirements.

For students preparing for the 2027 intake, finding a university that accepts Duolingo is only the first step. Applicants should also compare courses, check required scores, understand tuition costs and confirm the latest admission conditions before applying.

A common mistake is assuming that one university-wide policy applies to every department. In reality, a Business Management applicant and an Engineering applicant at the same institution may have different English language requirements.

Quick Answer: Is Duolingo Accepted In UK Universities?

Yes, many UK universities accept the Duolingo English Test for international student admissions. Most accepted scores usually range between 95 and 130, depending on the university, course level and programme requirements.

Important points for applicants:

  • Duolingo acceptance is decided by individual universities and courses.
  • Undergraduate and postgraduate requirements may differ.
  • Competitive programmes may ask for higher scores.
  • Some professional courses may have additional English conditions.

The Duolingo English Test is accepted by thousands of academic programmes worldwide. Students should always confirm the latest requirement with their chosen university before submitting an application.

Applicants comparing different English qualifications can also review English language requirements for UK university applications to understand how different tests are used.

What Is The Duolingo English Test (DET)?

The Duolingo English Test is an online English proficiency exam designed to measure whether students have the communication skills required for academic study.

Unlike traditional exams that usually require a test centre visit, DET can be completed online from home under secure testing conditions.

The test evaluates four key skills:

  • Reading
  • Writing
  • Listening
  • Speaking

DET uses computer-adaptive technology, meaning the difficulty level changes according to the candidate's responses. This allows the test to measure practical language ability rather than only memorised grammar knowledge.

Students can check the latest test format, rules and technical requirements through the official Duolingo English Test platform.

Why Are UK Universities Accepting Duolingo English Test?

For many years, UK universities mainly accepted traditional English tests such as IELTS Academic and TOEFL iBT. However, online assessment technology has changed how students demonstrate language ability.

Universities are increasingly recognising additional testing options because they provide:

Greater Accessibility

International students can complete the exam remotely without travelling to a test centre.

Faster Results

Students applying close to deadlines may benefit from quicker score availability.

Flexible Scheduling

Applicants can arrange the test around their academic planning.

However, convenience should not be the only deciding factor. The correct choice depends on whether your selected university and course accept DET.

Students planning their complete overseas education journey can also explore this study abroad guidance resource to understand application planning and destination options.

Are Duolingo Scores Accepted For Every UK Course?

No. A university accepting Duolingo does not automatically mean every programme accepts the same score.

Requirements can vary between:

  • Undergraduate courses
  • Postgraduate courses
  • MBA programmes
  • Research degrees
  • Foundation programmes
  • Professional courses

For example, a university may accept a specific DET score for a Business Management degree but require different English evidence for a healthcare or professional programme.

Students should always check the exact course requirement instead of relying only on the university name.

Duolingo Accepted Universities In UK For MBA

MBA applicants often have additional considerations because business schools may assess academic background, professional experience and communication ability.

Some UK business schools accept alternative English qualifications, including Duolingo, for selected MBA programmes.

When searching for Duolingo accepted universities in UK for MBA, students should check:

  • Minimum DET score
  • Work experience requirements
  • GMAT or GRE requirements where applicable
  • Interview process
  • Course-specific admission criteria

Business schools may have higher expectations because MBA programmes involve presentations, teamwork and professional communication.

A student with a good English score and relevant professional experience may have a stronger application compared with someone who only meets the minimum language requirement.

Chevening Scholarship

The Chevening Scholarship is one of the UK's most recognised international scholarship programmes. It supports outstanding students who demonstrate leadership potential and want to study a master's degree in the UK.

Benefits may include:

  • Tuition fee support
  • Living allowance
  • Travel costs
  • Additional academic support

Applicants usually need strong academic achievements, professional experience and evidence of leadership ability.

Commonwealth Scholarship

The Commonwealth Scholarship supports talented students from eligible Commonwealth countries who want to pursue postgraduate study in the UK.

  • University fees
  • Living expenses
  • Travel support

Eligibility depends on nationality, academic background and programme requirements.

GREAT Scholarships

The GREAT Scholarships programme, supported by the British Council and UK universities, provides financial assistance to students from selected countries.

These scholarships are usually offered for specific master's programmes and can provide significant tuition fee support.

Students should check available opportunities each year because participating universities and eligible countries may change.

Students should also consider whether they need:

How To Verify If A University Accepts Duolingo

University English requirements can change, and different courses may follow different policies.

Before applying, students should complete these checks:

1. Check The Official University Requirement Page

Look for the accepted English qualifications section on the university website.

2. Review The Exact Course Page

A university may accept Duolingo generally, but a specific programme may have additional conditions.

3. Check Score Requirements

Confirm:

  • Overall DET score
  • Individual skill scores
  • Test validity period
  • Required documents

4. Confirm Before Submitting Application

Always verify the latest information before paying application fees or submitting final documents.

The British Council also provides useful information about studying in the UK and international student guidance through its official resources.

Frequently Asked Questions

Which universities accept Duolingo 120 in UK?

A Duolingo score of 120 is accepted by many competitive UK universities, although requirements vary by course. Students should check individual programme requirements before applying.

Can international students use Duolingo for UK university admission?

Yes, many UK universities accept Duolingo English Test scores from international students for selected undergraduate and postgraduate programmes.

Can I study MBA in UK with Duolingo?

Yes, some UK universities accept Duolingo for MBA programmes. Applicants should confirm DET requirements, work experience conditions and other admission criteria.

Does Oxford accept Duolingo English Test?

Applicants should check Oxford's latest course-specific English requirements because acceptance policies can vary between programmes.

Does Cambridge accept Duolingo?

Cambridge applicants should review the English requirements for their chosen course before applying.

Is Duolingo 120 enough for Masters in UK?

A score of 120 can be competitive for many master's programmes, but universities may require different scores depending on subject and academic level.

Which Duolingo score is required for UK universities?

Most accepted scores vary between approximately 95 and 130 depending on the university, course and study level.

Conclusion

The growing number of Duolingo accepted universities in UK gives international students more flexibility when planning their education journey.

For the 2027 intake, students should focus on more than just finding a university that accepts DET. A successful application requires choosing the right course, achieving a suitable English score, planning finances and understanding admission requirements.

By researching universities carefully and verifying course-specific conditions, students can make a stronger decision about studying in the UK with Duolingo.
